cards.title: for loops
cards.body: A `for` loop has three parts: where to start, when to keep going, and how to step.

hi.title: for loops
hi.body: `for` loop ke teen hisse hote hain: kahan se shuru karna hai, kab tak chalna hai, aur kaise aage badhna hai.

cards.title: Other steps
cards.body: Change the step to count by 2, or count down with `i--` or `i -= 2`.

hi.title: Doosre steps
hi.body: Step badal kar 2-2 se gino, ya `i--` ya `i -= 2` se ulti ginti karo.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: It should print laps 1 to 5, but stops at lap 4. Tap the bug.

bug.fix: `i < 5` stops before 5. Use `i <= 5` to include it.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Isse laps 1 se 5 tak print karne chahiye, par yeh lap 4 par ruk jaata hai. Bug par tap karo.
hi.fix: `i < 5` 5 se pehle ruk jaata hai. 5 ko shaamil karne ke liye `i <= 5` use karo.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: It starts at 0 and stops before 3, because the condition is `i < 3`.

hi.question: Yeh kya print karega?
hi.explanation: Yeh 0 se shuru hota hai aur 3 se pehle ruk jaata hai, kyunki condition `i < 3` hai.

exercise.prompt: Read N and print the numbers from 1 to N, one per line. Use a `for` loop.
exercise.promptHi: N padho aur 1 se N tak ke numbers print karo, har line mein ek. `for` loop use karo.
exercise.starterCode:
const n = Number(prompt());
// print 1 to n, one per line
